title: Auto satin turns a 60° bend as PE-DESIGN does
description: A 5 mm band bent through 60° in satin with Auto direction, density 3, without under sewing, must turn its corner as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does: the rung direction turns evenly with the distance along the outer edge, over two band widths for a 60° turn.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-auto-bend-60.pes (under sewing off, density 3, 2026-10-27): 177 stitches; the rung direction turns from 90° to 150° at about 5.6° per mm of outer edge, centred on the outer corner (90° per three band widths, as on the 90° bend). PE imported the shape from SVG with its vertices on the 0.1 mm grid and centred it: 38.60 × 17.40 mm against the polygon's 38.66 × 17.50 mm.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw (or import) the closed polygon (0,0) (30,0) (38.66,15) (34.33,17.5) (27.11,5) (0,5) mm (a 5 mm band bent through 60°). Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Auto (Half Stitch at its default), Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-auto-bend-60.pes (under sewing off, density 3, 2026-10-27): the longest crossings are in the corner fan.
